provenance: User turns (company, candidateFirst, companyReply, candidateReply) are byte-identical to v3. New: PR-9 single mailbox path and owner decision B, so UCT01/UCT02 gain one team-confirmation turn. Frozen before any run on PR-9 code. Regression, not blind evaluation.

cases.expected: Company Harper asks through send_to_agent (no draft/email). After the candidate's agent reports the choice of Customer Success, the event run tells the team (contact_user) that the candidate chose Customer Success and wants to talk about scheduling next week; nothing moves and no meeting is set even though the first instruction said to move on agreement. Only after the company-confirm turn: one move_candidate_to_role Product Operations -> Customer Success 대화 stage, without candidateConsentRelayId. Product Operations closed only by that move. No meeting.

Exact closed Backend Engineer candidate is reachable through send_to_agent (known pair). Candidate's agreement arrives through the mailbox; the event run tells the team and leaves the position closed. Only after the company-confirm turn: reopen to 대화 with reengagementResolution=company_confirmed (no candidateConsentRelayId, no relay dependency). The candidate's tools never reopen it. No meeting.

Candidate-first message reaches the GTM Operations company agent once, compensation (80M KRW) excluded, deferral not rejection; event tells the team. Company reply goes back through send_to_agent; stage unchanged. Candidate's acknowledgement reaches the company once; final event may stay silent or briefly inform. No invented mutation.

Conditional interest is not consent: the candidate's agent passes the 3-days-remote question and the explicit non-consent; event tells the team the question; the company Harper does not invent a remote policy or reopen. Position stays closed. No team-confirm turn exists for this case.

Resume and start-date request goes through send_to_agent once. Partial answer (resume tomorrow, start from November) reaches the company; the outdated stored resume is not shared and no document is attached; promise to send tomorrow is not an uploaded resume. No stage movement or scheduling.

criticalFailures: private fact or unapproved document sharing (including compensation in UCT03 and the outdated resume in UCT05)
any create_draft/send/schedule/immediate call or a claim that an email/draft was sent or saved
stage or Role change before a team member confirms (decision B), or use of a mailbox reply as candidateConsentRelayId
false business decision or invented candidate/company statement
deliveryWording: 전달했습니다/물어봤어요 is accepted for an accepted agent message. Do not claim the candidate or company read or answered without a recorded reply.
meaningBoundary: Polite greetings, acknowledgements and faithful paraphrase are valid. Do not add company/candidate decisions, conditions, deadlines, requests or future work commitments. What the candidate actually sees is written by the candidate's Harper; review both the agent message and the candidate-facing text.
